title: CUT&RUN Abbreviated Protocol
author: Derek Janssens
materials: Rotate 5-10 min at room temperature. 00:10:00, Rotation

steps.title: Harvest and count cells
steps.instruction: Harvest fresh mammalian culture at room temperature, count cells and use up to 500 000 cells per sample.

steps.title: Bind cells to ConA beads
steps.instruction: While gently vortexing the cell suspension at room temperature, add ConA‑coated magnetic bead slurry.

steps.title: First wash of bead‑cell mix
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube 3 min at 600 × g, room temperature; withdraw supernatant, place tube on a magnet stand until clear and remove all liquid.

steps.title: Resuspend in Wash buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the bead‑cell pellet in 1.5 mL room‑temperature Wash buffer by gentle pipetting; transfer to a 2 mL tube if needed.

steps.title: Repeat wash two more times
steps.instruction: Repeat the centrifuge‑magnet‑wash cycle (steps 3‑4) two additional times to remove free sugars and contaminants.

steps.title: Final Wash with Antibody buffer
steps.instruction: Place the tube at a low angle on a vortex mixer set to low (~1100 rpm) and add 50‑150 µL Antibody buffer along the side while vortexing to dislodge beads; tap to release remaining beads, then place on magnet stand and remove all liquid.

steps.title: Aliquot for antibodies
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed bead‑cell pellet in 1 mL room‑temperature Wash Buffer, mix by vigorous inversion, and divide into 1.5‑mL tubes (one per primary antibody).

steps.title: Add primary antibody
steps.instruction: Add primary antibody to each tube to a final dilution of 1:100 (or the manufacturer’s recommended concentration).

steps.title: Antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes on a nutator or tube rotator at room temperature for ~2 h, or at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Wash with Dig‑wash buffer (small volume)
steps.instruction: Place each tube at a low angle on the vortex mixer (low ~1100 rpm) and add 100 µL Dig‑wash buffer along the side while vortexing to dislodge beads; tap to release remaining beads, place on magnet stand (~30 s) and remove all liquid.

steps.title: Wash with Dig‑wash buffer (large volume)
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Dig‑wash buffer, mix by inversion or gentle pipetting if clumps persist; place on magnet stand (~30 s) and remove all liquid.

steps.title: Repeat Dig‑wash cycles
steps.instruction: Repeat the two Dig‑wash steps (small‑volume then large‑volume) as described above for a total of two cycles.

steps.title: Add Protein A‑MNase
steps.instruction: Place each tube at a low angle on the vortex mixer (low ~1100 rpm) and add 150 µL Protein A‑MNase (or Protein A/G‑MNase) fusion protein at 700 ng/mL (1:200 of a 140 µg/mL glycerol stock) in Dig‑wash buffer; vortex to dislodge beads and tap to release remaining beads.

steps.title: MNase binding incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes on a nutator or tube rotator at 4 °C for ~1 h.

steps.title: Chill to 0 °C
steps.instruction: Insert tubes into the 1.5 mL wells of a heater block sitting in wet ice and chill to 0 °C.

steps.title: Add CaCl₂ for digestion
steps.instruction: Remove each tube from the block, add 2 µL 100 mM CaCl₂ (diluted 1:10 from a 1 M stock) with gentle vortexing, and immediately return the tube to the 0 °C block.

steps.title: MNase digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate at 0 °C for the desired digestion time (default 30 min).

steps.title: Stop digestion
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 2× STOP Buffer and mix by gentle vortexing. For multiple time points, remove 100 µL of each digestion and add to a new tube containing 100 µL 2× STOP Buffer, then vortex.

steps.title: Release chromatin fragments
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes 30 min at 37 °C to release CUT&RUN fragments from insoluble nuclear chromatin.

steps.title: Collect digested chromatin
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnet stand to clear; transfer the supernatant (~200 µL) containing digested chromatin to a fresh 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube for phenol‑chloroform extraction.

steps.title: Add SDS and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: To each sample add 2 µL 10 % SDS (to reach 0.1 % final) and 2.5 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL); mix by inversion and incubate 1 h at 50 °C.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction (first step)
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform (e.g., 200 µL to 200 µL sample), vortex at full speed for ~2 s, transfer to a phase‑lock tube (e.g., Qiagen MaXtract) and centrifuge 5 min at room temperature, 16 000 × g.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform (e.g., 200 µL), invert ~10 × to mix, and centrifuge 5 min at room temperature, 16 000 × g.

steps.title: Remove residual liquid
steps.instruction: Pulse‑spin the tube briefly in a micro‑centrifuge, place on a magnet stand for ~30 s, and remove all liquid from the cap and side.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with glycogen
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube containing 2 µL 2 mg/mL glycogen (1:10 diluted from a 20 mg/mL stock).

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 100 % ethanol, mix by vortexing or inversion, chill on ice and centrifuge 10 min at 4 °C, 16 000 × g.

steps.title: Wash pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Pour off the supernatant, drain on a paper towel, rinse the pellet with 1 mL 100 % ethanol, centrifuge 1 min at 4 °C, 16 000 × g, then pour off liquid and drain.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet for ~5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dry pellet in 30‑50 µL 1 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8, 0.1 mM EDTA and transfer to a new 0.6 mL Lo‑Bind microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Quantify library
steps.instruction: Measure library yield using a dsDNA‑specific assay such as Qubit.

steps.title: Assess library size
steps.instruction: Determine library size distribution with an Agilent 4200 TapeStation.

steps.title: Pool and sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Pool libraries at equimolar concentrations and perform paired‑end Illumina sequencing according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Align sequencing reads
steps.instruction: Align paired‑end reads with Bowtie2 v2.2.5 using options: --local --very-sensitive-local --no-unal --no-mixed --no-discordant --phred33 -I 10 -X 700 (add --no-overlap --no-dovetail for spike‑in mapping). Separate fragments into ≤120 bp and ≥150 bp size classes for downstream analysis.
